tasks.short: Research fire retardants and fire safety of materials/devices.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual fire-retardant research, material/device specifications and applicable test methods
inputs: actual published studies, specifications and approved methods

steps.what: Design actual research on retardant performance and material/device fire behaviour with appropriate controls
inputs: actual research objectives, samples and test-facility constraints
outputs: actual chosen study design and test conditions

steps.what: Conduct actual approved fire-retardant and material/device tests and capture primary observations
inputs: actual chosen study design and test conditions
actual samples, instruments and authorised test facility
outputs: actual measured test results, conditions and deviations

steps.what: Analyse actual evidence and determine defensible retardant and material/device fire-safety findings
inputs: actual measured test results, conditions and deviations
outputs: actual checked research findings and limitations

steps.what: Record and check final actual fire-safety research findings using verified study/material fields
inputs: actual checked research findings and limitations
actual measured test results, conditions and deviations
outputs: checked final actual fire-retardant/material research record

steps.what: Commit checked final actual fire-retardant/material research record
inputs: checked final actual fire-retardant/material research record

tasks.design: Configure native study/source links in {DATA_PLATFORM}, {PROJECT} and {DOCS}, with repeated study/material fields in the laboratory module of {OPS_SYSTEM}. Retain research design, all actual testing and interpretation, with new findings capture and full checking before a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research can repeat source navigation and stable study/material entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and laboratory fields can reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: Fire behaviour and defensible safety conclusions need actual appropriate experiments and engineering interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises that a favourable test result applies only to its tested configuration and conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less research administration; fire-safety science stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native study/source links and laboratory fields can assist research administration; they do not establish retardant effectiveness or material/device fire safety.

assumptions: Actual publishers/specification owners provide existing evidence; engineer verifies it and retains all scientific reading and applicability appraisal. Actual instruments/engineer produce primary data only during retained s3; all preparation, physical testing and observation remain counted.

S4 retains actual analysis and scientific judgement. S5 reduces stable study/sample identifiers only; all new results, limitations and full scientific/source checking remain. No invented test result, generic safety certification or unmeasured simulation saving.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native fields first; existing record prefill/instrument runtime earns zero new saving. Commit retains one percent using existing checking. Actual external findings report or material approval, if required, needs its own exact-final-version gated release/action with no avoided labour claimed.
unknowns: Which source navigation and study identifiers actually repeat?
research_questions: Can native links reduce administration after full scientific and result checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual research/source links and versioned study/material fields.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final actual research findings/limitations and exact study destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 source navigation + 9*0.20 repeated fields = 9.8; minus 1 upkeep = 8.8. Half eligible gives 4.9 minus 1 = 3.9. Scientific reading, design, physical tests, analysis, new capture/check and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Fire protection engineers retain research and safety judgement while actual repeated source/record administration may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual repeated administration while retaining all experiments, analysis and defensible safety conclusions.
